meta.subject: Science
meta.instructions: This question paper consists of 5 sections (A–E). Internal choices are provided in Sections B, C, D, and E.

sectionNotes.Section A: Objective type / Multiple Choice Questions (1 mark each).
sectionNotes.Section B: Very Short Answer questions (2 marks each).

questions.text: Which of the following is an amphoteric oxide?

questions.assertion: Silver chloride turns grey in sunlight.
questions.reason: Decomposition of silver chloride into silver and chlorine takes place by sunlight.
questions.answer: (a) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.

questions.text: Why does dry HCl gas not change the colour of dry litmus paper?
questions.answer: H+ ions are produced only in aqueous solution.

questions.text: Define power of a lens and write its SI unit. Find the power of a convex lens of focal length 25 cm.
questions.answer: P = 1/f (in m), SI unit Dioptre (D); P = +4 D.

questions.text: What are homologous series? Explain with two examples and state three characteristics.
questions.orText: Explain esterification and saponification reactions with balanced chemical equations.

questions.text: Mendel crossed tall pea plants (TT) with short pea plants (tt) and observed the F1 and F2 generations.
subQuestions: (i) What was the phenotype of the F1 generation? (1 Mark)
(ii) Write the phenotypic ratio of the F2 generation. (1 Mark)
(iii) State Mendel's Law of Dominance. (2 Marks)
questions.answer: (i) All tall (Tt). (ii) 3:1. (iii) Dominant allele expresses itself in heterozygous state.
